review_candidates.description: Structural Design Engineer – Irrigation & Road Infrastructure Projects Job Title: Structural Design Engineer Industry: Infrastructure / Irrigation / Roads & Highways Employment Type: Full-Time Experience: 3–8 years Location: [Location] Department: Engineering / Structural Design Reporting To: Senior Structural Engineer / Design Manager Perform structural analysis and design for irrigation and road infrastructure projects. * Design and detail RCC, PSC and steel structures in accordance with applicable Indian Standards and project specifications. * Undertake design of bridges, box culverts, slab culverts, retaining walls, wing walls, foundations, canal structures, aqueducts, cross-drainage structures, and other hydraulic/infrastructure structures. * Prepare structural calculations, design reports, technical specifications, and design notes. * Develop and review structural drawings, reinforcement details, bar bending schedules, and construction details. * Carry out analysis using relevant structural design software and prepare design models. * Coordinate with civil, geotechnical, hydraulic, roadway, survey, and other engineering disciplines. * Review drawings and designs prepared by junior engineers and ensure compliance with project requirements. * Assist in resolving structural and technical issues encountered during construction. * Review contractor/subcontractor submissions, shop drawings, method statements, and technical queries. * Conduct site visits when required to verify existing conditions and provide engineering solutions. * Ensure designs comply with relevant IS codes, IRC guidelines, MoRTH specifications, CPWD/State PWD requirements, and applicable project standards. * Participate in design reviews, coordination meetings, and technical discussions with clients and consultants. * Maintain quality, accuracy, and timely delivery of design packages.
